query: INSERT INTO series_prior (series_id, prior, watchers, velocity, recommendable, generation) SELECT * FROM unnest($1::uuid[], $2::real[], $3::int[], $4::real[], $5::bool[], $6::int[]) ON CONFLICT (series_id) DO UPDATE SET prior         = EXCLUDED.prior, watchers      = EXCLUDED.watchers, velocity      = EXCLUDED.velocity, recommendable = EXCLUDED.recommendable, generation    = EXCLUDED.generation, built_at      = now()
